subject: Mid-quarter steerboard: cross-team OKR triage + dependency queue
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Hsu <kate@orbitcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter steerboard: cross-team OKR triage + dependency queue

Team —

Quick mid-quarter pulse and concrete asks ahead of the QBR next month. I ran the OKR heatmap with product and infra this morning; headline: overall progress is steady but three workstreams are blocking unit economics and the OrbitCloud integration we committed to for the QBR. I want to align on minimal re-scopes and owners so we don't ship a half-baked experience.

Summary (high level) —
- KR: Reduce per-token inference cost by 18% (current trajectory ~8%). Blocked by two infra items (KV cache hot-path and batching config).
- KR: OrbitCloud P0 integration (demo + perf numbers) — integration parity is functionally complete but latency SLO fails at scale.
- KR: Console rollout for per-route throttles — on track but needs product sign-off on UX and an infra toggle.

Concrete asks (please reply with owner + ETA by EOD Monday):
1) Infra: Prioritize KV cache hot-path optimization (PR around memory churn). Recommended temporary re-scope: postpone noncritical quantization profiler until after QBR. Owner: @markus_klein — ETA?
2) Product/Platform: Freeze console UX changes to the per-route throttle flow for the QBR demo; ship a documented fallback toggle instead. Owner: @laura_bennett — can you confirm freeze window and who will own the fallback docs?
3) Integration: OrbitCloud performance tuning — need 2 days of dedicated infra load-testing and a short-networking config change (proxy settings). Owner: @vanessa_ortiz can we commit 2 FTE-days from your team?

I attached a draft QBR packet and a dependency tracker with rows for each critical item (see attachments). Kate — looping you so OrbitCloud sees the plan and we can align the demo expectations; we should decide if we push the customer demo to the later slot in the QBR if we can't get the SLO to a comfortable place.

I'll collect responses and publish an updated dependency queue + owners doc. Thanks — small, concrete commitments here will keep the QBR credible.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: dependency-tracker.csv (CSV)]
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter steerboard: cross-team OKR triage + dependency queue

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear callout. Quick responses inline: 

> 1) Infra: Prioritize KV cache hot-path optimization... Owner: @markus_klein — ETA?

We have a patchset (INF-4820) in review that reduces KV churn; if we allocate one senior SWE to unblock the benchmark infra, I can get a measurable improvement in 4 business days (ETA: 2026-07-06). Short re-scope suggestion: move the quantization profiler (low impact for QBR) to the post-QBR backlog. That frees a pair of engineers this week to focus on the hot-path.

> 2) Product/Platform: Freeze console UX changes... Owner: @laura_bennett — can you confirm freeze window and who will own the fallback docs?

Agree with freeze. If we freeze changes today, we can ship the fallback toggle (infra-controlled) by 2026-07-02. We'll need one UI dev and one PM to finalize copy.

> 3) Integration: OrbitCloud performance tuning... Owner: @vanessa_ortiz can we commit 2 FTE-days from your team?

I can support the load-testing slot if Vanessa can free up JVM/edge expertise for the proxy change.

Action items from infra:
- Re-scope quantization profiler -> post-QBR backlog (confirmed).
- Allocate 1 senior SWE to INF-4820 benchmarks -> in progress, target 2026-07-06.
- Prepare a canary plan for the cache hot-path change with rollback window.

Markus
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Tessa / Markus —

We can commit the 2 FTE-days for OrbitCloud tuning next Wed/Thu (2026-07-01/02). I'll allocate one backend engineer (edge networking) and one systems engineer (JVM tuning). Caveat: hiring cadence means we are tight on ongoing Dedicated rollouts the following week, so this is a short, focused slot only.

I'll also work with infra on the canary plan; Markus, please share the rollback checklist and I'll make sure my team has the runbook.

A couple of pragmatic re-scope suggestions from my side: 
- For the QBR demo, if we cannot consistently hit the SLO at >10k tokens/min, we should demonstrate the integration with a synthetic dataset limited to high-recall paths and call out the throughput limitations in the notes. That preserves the functional demo while being transparent.
- If infra needs more runway on the KV fix, we could showcase a 'performance tuning' slide with before/after estimates and timeline rather than live numbers.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Platform & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses. Consolidating owners and next steps below (I'll update the dependency-tracker CSV and share a final QBR packet by Tuesday):

Decisions & owners:
- KV cache hot-path: Owner: Markus Klein. ETA for measurable uplift: 2026-07-06. Action: allocate 1 senior SWE; infra to provide canary + rollback checklist by 2026-06-30.
- Quantization profiler: moved to post-QBR backlog (accepted).
- Console UX freeze: Owner: Laura Bennett. Freeze window confirmed: effective now through 2026-07-08. Fallback toggle doc owner: Laura; draft due 2026-07-02.
- OrbitCloud tuning: Owner: Vanessa Ortiz. 2 FTE-days confirmed for 2026-07-01/02. Kate/Contracts: please confirm whether we should keep the customer demo slot or move it to the afternoon slot (we're aiming for transparency if perf numbers are not final).

Deliverables for Tuesday (2026-06-30 EOD):
- Infra: Canary & rollback checklist (Markus).
- Product: Fallback toggle docs and one-sheeter for QBR slide (Laura).
- Integration: Post-load-test summary and recommended demo plan (Vanessa).
- Tessa: Publish updated dependency-tracker + QBR packet (I will attach).

Attachments updated: QBR-packet-draft.pdf (v2) and dependency-tracker.csv (rows with owners and ETAs). Kate — noted your ask about a written SLA note; I'll include a short slide on what we can commit vs. what we will keep as a follow-up deliverable.

If no objections I will lock the re-scopes and update the master doc tonight.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
